snippet.title: Sort of Magic - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A cozy organizing game for 1–4 players in online co-op. You're a little magical cat who knocked over an entire magic school. Now put all 4,500 books, potions, and brooms back exactly where they belong. Learn sorting spells, split the rooms with friends, and restore the mess you made.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4398290/Sort_of_Magic/
